title: Academy integration checked; repository release checks remain open
summary: New onboarding, planning, navigation and Agent Studio flows pass focused and browser checks. Full suite: 370 passed, six existing snapshot/test-harness failures remain. Not deployed.

changes.detail: Eight academy destinations, seven flexible sessions prioritizing due recall, and a bounded agent tool runner with observable trace and failure checks.
Onboarding supports skipping and optional interests, routine goals and accessibility notes. Existing profile shape remains readable.
Home, progress and search connect to the new screens. Existing lessons, consoles, authentication and wellness storage are preserved.
Optional preference sharing is off by default; teacher and tutor transports omit new optional details until explicitly enabled. Saved generated courses participate in weekly planning.
All quiz questions require spaced recall before the planner advances. Agent projects distinguish unsaved edits and show corrupt-project recovery. Updated Home and transport test harness dependencies.
Course tab is named Learn; Explore links to interactive discovery. Added audit, implementation details and remaining product work.

validation.detail: 376 tests: 370 passed, 6 failed. Existing stale source snapshot, course API cwd-dependent path and four tutor-coach world-content mock imports. See artifacts/academy-ecosystem-tests-final.log.

validation.detail: No production deployment, APK build, live AI/auth, physical device or Arabic/French visual verification. Expert curricula, autonomous LLM agent runtime and offline owner-auth startup remain open.
